page_title: MON 2-0 MNT | Monaco v Montpellier 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Surely that's handball by one of the Montpellier players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+1' What was Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 2:0.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Montpellier decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
89' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
87' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Maghnes Akliouche is replaced by Edan Diop (Monaco).
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.

86' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Now Montpellier have a corner.

85' Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
85' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

84' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The referee signals a corner kick to Monaco.
84' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
84' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
82' The foul by Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) was seen by Jeremy Stinat who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Krepin Diatta (Monaco) will replace Vanderson.
80' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) dribbles into the box, but Benjamin Lecomte is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
78' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
76' Lucas Mincarelli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Christopher Jullien (Montpellier).
76' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a change. Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) replaces Akor Adams.
76' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
74' Substitution. Folarin Balogun will be replaced by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco).
73' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Benjamin Lecomte intercepts the ball.
72' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
71' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
69' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) has to leave the pitch!

69' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier), but referee Jeremy Stinat must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
68' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
67' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
64' PENALTY APPEAL after Folarin Balogun (Monaco) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
61' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) replacing Falaye Sacko.
61' A substitution has been made. Wahbi Khazri is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
61' The ball is played back to Vanderson (Monaco), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.
60' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
59' Ball possession – 63:37.
58' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
53' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

53' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.

50' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Benjamin Lecomte is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
49' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' Monaco keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+2' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
45+2' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
45+2' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Monaco win a corner.
45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is booked by the referee.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from Montpellier is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
44' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Montpellier will take a corner.

42' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
42' The goal by Monaco won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
41' Monaco score a goal, but referee Jeremy Stinat has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
40' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

39' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
37' Vanderson (Monaco) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
37' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and Monaco manage to earn a corner.
36' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.

35' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is free in the box and Aleksandr Golovin finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance! The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
34' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn was alert and made a comfortable save.
31' A pass lands at the feet of Akor Adams (Montpellier) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
30' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
29' Poor challenge! Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is penalised for tripping and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Monaco.
27' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post.

25' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
25' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

24' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the top right corner, but Benjamin Lecomte is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Monaco force their opponents to concede a corner.
24' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
21' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
21' The resulting free kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
20' Vanderson (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
20' Looks like Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
16' Akor Adams (Montpellier) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
15' Akor Adams (Montpellier) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Philipp Kohn.

14' Vanderson (Monaco) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
11' The free kick is delivered by Teji Savanier (Montpellier) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
9' 1 - 0 Goal 1:0! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
9' Vanderson (Monaco) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Benjamin Lecomte anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
8' A pass by Mohamed Camara (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
6' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
5' Some patient build-up play from Monaco as they look to unlock the defence.
4' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Monaco will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will supervise the game today.
